body.p: The present application has been reviewed in view of the Non-Final Office Action dated November 9, 2023. Claims 21-23, 25-28, and 40 are pending, with claims 21, 32, and 40 being independent. Claims 1-20 were previously canceled and claims 24 and 39 are canceled herein. Claims 21, 32, and 40 are amended. Applicant respectfully submits that the present Amendment introduces no new matter.
In view of the preceding amendments to the claims and the remarks to follow, reconsideration and allowance of this application are respectfully requested.
Applicant thanks Examiner Knox for indicating that claims 24 and 39 would allowable if rewritten in independent form including all the limitations of the base claims and any intervening claims.

Independent claims 21 and 32 have been amended to incorporate the allowable subject matter of claims 24 and 39, respectively. Claims 24 and 39 are canceled rendering any objection to claims 24 and 39 moot.

The Office Action rejected claims 21-23, 26-36, 38, and 40 under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Pat. App. Pub. No. 2010/0030045 by Gottlieb et al. ("Gottlieb '045"), in view of Pat. App. Pub. No. 2011/0319734 by Gottlieb et al. ("Gottlieb '734").

Without conceding the propriety of the rejection, independent claims 21, 32, and 40 have been amended to incorporate the allowable subject matter of claims 24 and 39. Therefore, Applicant respectfully submits that independent claims 21, 32, and 40 are not obvious over Gottlieb '045 and Gottlieb '734 and are patentable.

Claims 22, 23, and 25-31 depend from amended independent claim 21. Therefore, Applicant respectfully submits that dependent claims 22, 23, and 25-31 are also patentable for at least the same reasons as amended independent claim 21.
Claims 33-38 depend from amended independent claim 32. Therefore, Applicant
respectfully submits that dependent claims 33-38 are also patentable for at least the same reasons as amended independent claim 32.
For at least these reasons, Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejections of the claims under 35 U.S.C. § 103.
In view of the foregoing amendments and remarks, it is respectfully submitted that all claims presently pending in the application are in condition for allowance.

Applicant does not concede that the subject matter encompassed by the claims prior to this Amendment is unpatentable over the art cited by the Office Action. In addition, to the extent that amendments included herein constitute a narrowing of the claims, such narrowing of the claims should not be construed as an admission as to the merits of the prior rejections. Indeed, Applicant traverses the rejections and preserves all rights and arguments. To the extent that any particular statement or argument by the Office in the pending Office Action is not explicitly addressed herein, the same should not be construed as an acquiescence or admission by the Applicant that such statements or arguments by the Office are accurate and proper.

If the Examiner should have any questions concerning this communication or feels that an interview would be helpful, the Examiner is requested to call the Applicant's undersigned attorney at the Examiner's convenience.

Please charge any deficiency as well as any other fee(s) that may become due under 37 C.F.R. § § 1.16 and/or 1.17 at any time during the pendency of this application, or credit any overpayment of such fee(s), to Deposit Account No. 13-2546.
